en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling market square. On the left is a large baroque-style town hall with a tower and clock; beside it stands a Gothic church with tall pointed windows and a steep roof. The square in front is filled with rows of market stalls and many people. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with shops. The caption at the top in red German text reads "Weissenfels a. Saale. Markt und Rathaus."
